title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Run your own brothel: register workers, send customers to them or take customers yourself, and SkyrimNet's AI voices every offer and answer while OStim or SexLab plays the scene.
description:
SkyrimNet Brothel lets you turn any interior into a brothel, and you can run up to three of them at once. It works with OStim Standalone or SexLab, whichever you have; with both, you choose one in the MCM. You register workers, women or men (followers or anyone else, or all your followers at once), or let the brothel hire workers of its own, and customers walk up to them and make paid offers. SkyrimNet's AI writes and voices each offer and the worker's answer, the worker can accept or refuse, and the scene plays on a free bed.

You can also take customers yourself and answer them by picking AI-written lines in the dialogue menu, including which position you want, or buy a worker's company with your own gold. The choice system is built into the mod, so SkyrimNet Player Choices is not needed.

People from the brothel's town can walk over during opening hours and become customers, and you can choose whether customers are men, women or both. Workers and customers who know each other, such as friends, lovers or regulars, talk like it, and relatives never do business together. You can name yourself or an NPC as the owner, who takes a share of every payment, recommends workers to customers and talks to the workers about their takings. Experienced workers invite customers on their own, workers chat among themselves between customers, and the brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10 that change how they feel about the work.

Customers pay up front and get their gold back if the deal falls through. Everything is set up in an MCM with six pages, and a Manage Brothel power opens a menu with the main settings while you play. The mod requires OStim Standalone or SexLab P+ (SexLab 1.6x is supported but has not been tested in game), MCM Helper, PapyrusUtil and powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, and UIExtensions is needed only for the Manage Brothel power. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive.
author: taka
changelog: 0.4.0: The brothel now supports OStim Standalone as well as SexLab. Install either one and the mod uses it; with both installed, a new MCM setting chooses which one plays the brothel's scenes, and you can switch at any time while scenes already playing finish in the framework they began in. Everything works on OStim, including taking customers yourself with the position you pick and a free bed for every pair. Other changes: the positions you are offered when you take a customer are the ones a bed of the brothel has scenes for, two pairs no longer get the same bed in a brothel with many beds, the lines you pick from when you make an offer now read as your own words, and the watchdog no longer ends a deal that has just started.
